newsitem.title: USA: Primus Telecommunications Q1 shr loss.
newsitem.headline: Primus Telecommunications Q1 shr loss.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Pro forma net loss for the first quarter of 1996 was $1,189,000 on revenues of $43,505,000. Pro forma net loss per share was $0.10, on 12,385,000 weighted common shares outstanding.
Pro rorma results for first-quarter 1996 include results for the entire quarter of PRIMUS's Australian telecommunications subsidiary acquired in March 1996.

In 1996, the company calculated earnings per share following Securities and Exchange Commission regulations related to initial public offerings. In the first quarter of 1997, in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, the weighted average shares do not include 1,699,000 shares of common stock equivalents associated with optiions and warrants.
